verdict.rationale: AMD's Ryzen docs state a multi-year socket support commitment and say buyers can upgrade to next-gen CPUs later, which covers the core upgrade-path promise. They do not name the socket for this CPU in any quoted text, and the commitment gives no specific generations or end date. missing for 10: explicit socket identification (e.g. AM5) in the product documentation, a concrete stated support timeline or generation count, independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in upgrade compatibility.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can upgrade the CPU without replacing the platform — a documented socket with a stated multi-generation support commitment

citations.quote: AMD is the only processor manufacturer committed to multi-year socket support, giving you the freedom to start with what fits your build today and upgrade to next-gen performance tomorrow.
Invest in a platform that grows with your needs over time
